criteria.criterion: For a six-team input the schedule contains exactly 5 weeks and exactly 3 matches per week.
For a five-team input the schedule contains exactly 5 weeks with 2 real matches and 1 BYE slot per week, and every team receives the BYE exactly once.
Across all weeks in both fixtures every pair of real teams appears as opponents exactly once.
No real team name appears more than once within any single week in either fixture.
The total count of real non-BYE matches in each fixture equals n*(n-1)/2.
Every team name supplied in the input file appears literally in the printed output.
The tool is invoked as 'python3 round_robin.py <file>' with a single argument and exits with code 0 on valid input.
